Ava (People Ops): Quick heads-up — we're finalizing a new 'Community Service Leave' policy to add to the handbook. It grants up to 5 paid days/year for verified volunteering (US/CA/EMEA to start). There is a manager verification step and an e-sign acknowledgement for employees. Please skim the proposed copy and ack by EOD Thu if there are no flags: https://handbook.internal.redwood/policies/community-service-leave-v1 :sparkles:

Jamal (People Ops): link 404 for me?

Ava (People Ops): sorry — updated link, try this one: https://handbook.internal.redwood/policies/community-service-leave-v1?rev=3 — should work now.

Priya (HR Manager): Quick Q: how are we tracking manager signoffs? Do managers need to upload anything or will People Ops capture confirmations?

Ava (People Ops): Good Q. Workflow: employee submits volunteer request in the HR portal -> manager approves in the portal -> e-sign pop-up for employee (ack of policy) -> acks auto-export to People Ops. We also created a lightweight manager verification CSV export for audit.

Leo (Eng Manager): Can you paste the export command/SQL? I want to add it to my quarterly audit steps.

Ava (People Ops): Yep — here's the CLI we put in the README. Run weekly or after a rollout:
```
# export manager confirmations for date range
python tools/hr_exports.py --export community_service_confirmations --start 2026-04-01 --end 2026-06-30 --format csv > /tmp/cs_confirmations.csv
# or run quick BigQuery:
SELECT employee_id, manager_id, approved_at, policy_version FROM `redwood-hr.prod.community_service_confirmations` WHERE approved_at BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-06-30';
```
(we'll add both to the ops playbook)

benefits-bot: Automated export scheduled: community_service_confirmations exported to gs://redwood-hr-exports/community_service_confirmations/2026-05-11.csv — checksum OK :white_check_mark:

Priya (HR Manager): Thanks, that helps. For EMEA we need local-language copy + legal review. i18n-team, can you estimate translation turnaround for the policy page + notification email?

Ava (People Ops): we're planning to ship English + EMEA translations in the first wave. APAC will follow after legal checks. Also planning two live Q&A drop-ins (Americas/EMEA) next week.

i18n-team: We can turn around translations in ~5 business days for EMEA (EN->FR/DE/ES/NL). Need final text freeze (no further wording changes) before we start.

Leo (Eng Manager): One minor ask — can we add a manager checklist item to the template: 'confirm organization does not consider event as company-sponsored paid event' to avoid confusion about team-organized charity runs?

Ava (People Ops): Good catch — will add a Manager Checklist bullet. I'll update the draft and ping this thread.

Jamal (People Ops): For tracking, I'm preparing a short spreadsheet for managers that includes: employee, dates, hours, manager signoff timestamp, handbook_version, training_ack_timestamp. Will post link once ready.

Priya (HR Manager): I'll put this on my 1:1 agenda with managers this week. Planning to shepherd legal signoff for EMEA.

Ava (People Ops): Final note — we'll require employee e-signature for the policy change (ack) within 30 days of rollout. People Ops will run periodic exports and surface any missing acks to managers. I'll upload the first ack export to the People Ops drive by Friday morning and tag managers. Thanks :pray:
